name: Random Access of Compressed Data (Westermann's Method)
aliases: Mask and Offset Layout for Wavelets
definition: A data layout technique to support random access to wavelet coefficients stored in compressed linear arrays, overcoming the variable length of Huffman codes.
summary: Westermann's Method enables constant-time random access to compressed wavelet data by organizing coefficients into hierarchical blocks with split offset arrays, avoiding sequential decoding overhead.
